author: Simone Ramella
attribution: Photo: Simone Ramella, CC BY 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/12557829@N00/32873484406. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Bern: two brown/cream hotel finger-sign stacks on one pole; left stack (arrows pointing left): HOTELS / Ador / City / National; right stack (arrows pointing right): HOTELS / Bären / Bellevue / Bristol. Lines listed left stack then right stack. Language tags: German-speaking city, so the header and the hotel names are tagged de (City is an English loanword, Ador/National/Bristol are proper names), except 'Bellevue' which is French. A-umlaut in Bären. Source is a 1024 px Flickr rendition.
